description:
![Picture](https://i.postimg.cc/PxtCPvSt/1715c327-74a6-45fa-915b-eef634487565.png)

Guess that I am back. After the amazing done by a modder, most Yu-Ris games can be decompiled. The perks of Yu-RIS being an open source engine, is like with KiriKiri, most games can have their files replaced with the standard executable from the source code and have the game load the files loose.
Even so, it ain't that easy most of the time. Still though, I have decided to release this game in particular because it featured AlphaRom DRM, and there was no proper crack released for it until now. As per usual with this engine, Locale Emulator is while not mandatory, it is recommended.
